schemes.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.for_whom: Top 20% scorers in Class 12 going to college
schemes.levels: UG and PG (regular degree courses, not diploma)
schemes.benefit: ₹12,000 a year for the first three years of graduation; ₹20,000 a year at postgraduation (and years 4–5 of integrated courses)
schemes.window: National Scholarship Portal (NSP), usually June to October

rules.label: Family income up to ₹4.5 lakh a year
rules.quote: Students with gross parental/family income upto ₹ 4.5 lakh per annum are eligible for scholarship under the scheme.

rules.label: Above the 80th percentile of your Class 12 board, in your stream
rules.quote: Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream

rules.label: Regular UG or PG degree course (not diploma, not distance mode)
rules.quote: Pursuing regular degree courses and not correspondence or distance mode or pursuing Diploma courses;

rules.label: Not receiving another scholarship or fee waiver

checks.text: Your college must be recognised by AICTE or the relevant regulator.

notes: From 2026-27 the NSP lets students hold one merit-based plus welfare-based scholarships, which may relax the "no other scholarship" rule. Confirm on NSP before giving up another scholarship.

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Castes
schemes.for_whom: SC students from Class 11 up to PhD
schemes.benefit: Compulsory fees (including tuition) plus an academic allowance of ₹2,500–₹13,500 a year depending on course and hostel
schemes.window: NSP or your state scholarship portal; state deadlines vary (often October–November)

rules.label: Belongs to a Scheduled Caste of your State/UT
rules.quote: Only those candidates who belong to Scheduled Castes so specified in relation to the State/Union Territory

rules.label: Parents' income up to ₹2.5 lakh a year
rules.quote: Scholarships will be paid to the students whose parents'/guardians' income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2,50,000/- (Rupees Two lakh Fifty thousand only) during the last Financial Year.

rules.label: Studying after Class 10 (Class 11 up to PhD)
Not holding another scholarship or stipend
rules.quote: A scholarship holder under this scheme will not hold any other scholarship/stipend.

checks.text: Not eligible for a second course at the same stage (e.g. a second graduation).

notes: The guideline period ends with 2025-26, but states are running the scheme for 2026-27. News reports (March 2026) say the income limit may rise to ₹4.5 lakh; that is not official yet.
